Instead of that I would like the student answer and my predefined answer to be sent for chatgpt with the prompt of asking it how simliar the students answer is to the predefined answer. title: Data Visualization Expert Needed
description:
We’re looking to hire someone experienced in data visualization to provide both consultation and execution of our project. Currently we utilize multiple excel workbooks and sheets to track project data, history, progress, location, costs, etc.

Our goal is to consolidate as much data as we can to a single workbook and then tie the outputs to a more visual “dashboard” (or multiple dashboards) that is more attractive and refined. The desired dashboard would be optimized for visualization with the option for easy exporting when dynamic infographics may be required for use in reports and presentations.
Examples of this data include project-based revenue, profit, date, location, product types, project type, etc...

Goal:
• To consolidate these worksheets into one (or fewer), easy-to-use dashboards/workbooks with different visualizations (i.e., maps, graphs, charts, etc..)

b. Input sheets should not need maintenance and should be able to be edited or modified without a ton of work. We will need to know how to add new sheets for recording data for the following year, etc…
c. One dashboard should be a US map that has filters relating to the projects we have done in each state in order to derive information quickly and easily from it

Your Role:
• Analyze data and provide consultation on the best platform and strategy for data organization and visualization
• Conceptualize and develop the back-end of data organization for optimal data management workflow
• Build & customize data visuals to suit the desired result and end use
• Ideally, you are proficient in SQL, Google Data Studio, Power BI, Excel (Pivot Tables, macros, etc..), Tableau, etc.
• PLEASE NOTE: we are leaning towards using Google Data Studio or Power BI, so we'd like someone that is experienced working with these in addition to Tableau.

Pre-award Consultation meeting:
• We would like to arrange a video consultation before awarding the project so that we are clear and comfortable with whom we will be working with. Please do not submit if you are not comfortable with this. We estimate this would only take 15 – 30min.

If you feel you would be a good fit, please provide examples of your previous work or portfolio and confirm that you are comfortable with scheduling a consultation. Please do not submit if you have not read the full project description, we will not respond to those that clearly have not. We have lots of other projects that require visualization and excel assistance so this would not be your only project with us if all goes well!

NOTE: Since the data you would be working with is confidential information, you would need to sign an NDA agreeing not to disclose the information we provide.

We look forward to hearing from you!
